translations.text: The elder, to the chosen Kyria and her children, whom I love in truth—and not I alone, but also all who have come to know the truth—
because of the truth that remains in us and is with us forever.
May grace, mercy, and peace be with us from God the Father and from our Lord Jesus Christ, the Father's Son, in truth and love.
I rejoiced greatly to find some of your children living in truth, just as we received a commandment from the Father.
And now I ask you, Kyria—not as though I were writing you a new commandment, but the one we have had from the beginning—that we love one another.
And this is love: that we live according to his commandments. This is the commandment, just as you heard from the beginning, that you should live by it.
For many deceivers have gone out into the world, who do not acknowledge that Jesus Christ came in the flesh. Such a person is the deceiver and the antichrist.
Watch yourselves, so that you do not lose what you have worked for, but receive a full reward.
Anyone who goes beyond and does not remain in the teaching of Christ does not have God in him. Whoever remains in his teaching has both the Father and the Son.
If anyone comes to you and does not bring this teaching, do not receive him into your house or say to him, “Greetings.”
For whoever says “Greetings” to him shares in his evil deeds.
Although I had many things to write to you, I did not want to do so with paper and ink. Instead, I hope to come to you and speak face to face, so that our joy may be complete.
The children of your chosen sister send you greetings. Amen.
